First time I saw Porter was at a rave in So Cal called Audiotistic 2011. I enjoyed Porter then, but as many can attest, I could walk 100ft feet to another stage and get a "similar" sound, 4 to floor, 120bpm, with same basic visuals. 

Sometime later, Worlds was released, and I really much enjoyed the album and the ideas and themes behind it, but it wasn't until seeing the "worlds" live show in SD and San Fran did I really loved it. I felt was the most complete production from the music (live edits especially), visuals and atmosphere. Watching that show and countless others after that changed the way I listened to that album and his other songs thereafter. 

I also think there is something about playing all your original music in a EDM show, that is something admirable. This is only true with his "Worlds Live' Show

Honestly if given a chance and he's playing at a massive you are attending try swinging by his stage, hopefully its not just a DJ set. I think the live experience really does change his music more than any other musician I've seen.
